archetypes.name: Collar Kitten
archetypes.writeup: Affectionate on your own terms. You want to belong to someone, to be cared for, played with, and claimed, but you keep the curiosity and independence that make a kitten a kitten. The collar means something to you.

archetypes.name: Hunter
archetypes.writeup: You do the choosing. You watch, you test, and you let someone in slowly, and only the ones who earn it stay. A Dom who wants you has to prove he's worth the trust.

archetypes.name: Brat
archetypes.writeup: You push to see if he'll push back. Attitude is part of the fun, and you want a Dom who can keep up and win, with a grin.

archetypes.name: Service Sub
archetypes.writeup: You show devotion by doing. Tasks, projects, and taking care of your Dom's needs feel like closeness to you, and being noticed for it matters.

archetypes.name: Masochist
archetypes.writeup: For you, the sting is the point. Intensity from someone you trust takes you somewhere good, and the marks are a souvenir.

archetypes.name: Praise Seeker
archetypes.writeup: Praise is your fuel. You want to be seen, told you did well, and know your Dom is proud of you.

archetypes.name: Degradee
archetypes.writeup: You like being put in your place. Being made to feel naughty, dirty, or humiliated, safely and by someone you trust, flips a switch.

archetypes.name: Rope Bunny
archetypes.writeup: Restraint sets you free. Rope, cuffs, and blindfolds take away the choices and let you drop into the moment.

archetypes.name: Primal Prey
archetypes.writeup: You want the chase. The struggle, being caught, and being pinned is the thrill. It's raw and physical.

archetypes.name: Exhibitionist
archetypes.writeup: You like to be seen. Being watched or shown off while you submit turns the volume up.

archetypes.name: Protocol Sub
archetypes.writeup: Structure makes you feel held. Rules, rituals, titles, and consequences give the dynamic shape, and you like living inside it.

questions.question: I'm the one who decides who gets close to me.
I'd happily wear a collar that shows who I belong to.
Sometimes I disobey just to see what happens.
Doing small tasks for my Dom makes me feel close to him.
I enjoy the sting of impact and want more of it.
Hearing "good girl" does something to me.
Being tied up helps me let go.
I'd enjoy being chased, caught, and pinned down.
Being watched while I submit excites me.
I like clear rules, even outside the bedroom.
Being called degrading names in the moment turns me on.
Being called a good kitty and getting my head scratched sounds perfect.
I'd rather choose my Dom than be chosen.
A little attitude makes the game more fun.
I like having assignments and projects to complete.
Pain feels good when it comes from someone I trust.
I want detailed praise when I do well.
I love not being able to move or see.
I like play that feels wild and physical, not scripted.
I'd enjoy being shown off at a play party.
Rituals like good-morning messages, positions, and titles make me feel held.
I like being made to feel a little naughty or humiliated.
I'm playful, curious, and a little aloof until I decide to curl up with someone.
I test a Dom slowly before I let him in.
I want a Dom who can win when I push back.
Taking care of my Dom's needs is satisfying in itself.
I'm proud of my marks the next day.
Knowing my Dom is proud of me matters more than the play itself.
Blindfolds make everything more intense for me.
Struggling against someone stronger is exciting.
Being photographed during play appeals to me.
Facing consequences when I break a rule feels right, not unfair.
Sometimes I'd rather be put in my place than praised.
Ears, a tail, or a bell during play sound fun to me.
A Dom has to earn my submission over time.
I'd rather be caught than simply obey.
